eyebrow: The four verbs you'll actually use

steps.label: GET
steps.sub: read a resource — never changes data

steps.label: POST
steps.sub: create a new resource, like a new invoice

steps.label: PATCH
steps.sub: update part of an existing resource

steps.label: DELETE
steps.sub: remove a resource — rarely allowed on financial records

code:
GET   /invoices/300000182   -> read the invoice
PATCH /invoices/300000182   -> update a field on it
POST  /invoices             -> create a brand-new invoice
caption: The resource's address doesn't change; the method changes what happens to it.
